text:
ryan: quick flag  perf shows host ingress CPU spike around 09:12 UTC. tiny streamed frames (~64-200B) -> many writev syscalls. tail latency climbs.

zoe: paste of perf sample: 
```
35%  syscall_writev
12%  parse_fragment
10%  kernel_picker_select
8%   utf8_normalize
5%   kv_cache_miss
```

miguel: KV miss rate up 2% in that window; eviction noted after mem pressure. Also saw kernel_picker choose non-vector kernel for short seqs.

ryan: quick staging tweaks: bumped edge coalesce 128->768 bytes -> syscall rate -40%, host CPU -10%, 95p -25ms.

zoe: good signal IO. proposal: default coalesce -> 512, add --ingress-coalesce-delay-ms=0.8, and emit telemetry mapping ingress_coalesce_bytes->kernel_id. also pin kv cache on canary nodes.

miguel: will add alert if kv miss delta >1%/5m and pin cache. i'll also add kernel_picker histogram.

perf-bot: scheduled perf job: nightly/ingress-coalesce-ab. baseline vs canary.

ryan: rollout plan: 10% -> 50% -> 100% if 95p improves or flat. rollback if 95p + host-token CPU increase >7% within 30m. assign zoe for proxy PR, miguel for kernel telemetry.
